exposure: growth direction of the gestational sac
outcome: Major bleeding (>500 mL blood loss with curettage)
cohort: 31 consecutive patients with CSP at 6 to 9 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found that the exogenous and mixed types of GS growth direction, an RMT < 2 mm, and multiple lacunae in thickened chorionic parenchyma may be high-risk factors for major hemorrhage during curettage for CSP.
